name: redmine
title: Redmine
description: Integrate with the Redmine issue system (https://www.redmine.org/)
author: jwickers

commands.name: created-by-me
commands.title: Created by Me
commands.description: Shows the open issues you created

commands.name: issue
commands.title: My Issues
commands.description: Shows the open issues assigned to you

tools.name: search-issues
tools.title: Search Issues
tools.description: Search the Redmine issue tracker by keyword (open or closed), or list issues by status and assignee. Returns structured issue data (id, subject, status, priority, project, assignee, url, description).

preferences.name: domain
preferences.title: Redmine Domain
preferences.description: Your Redmine domain or base URL path (e.g. 'mycompany.redmine.org' or 'http://mycompany.redmine.org:8080/redmine')

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Your API token as described at https://www.redmine.org/boards/2/topics/53956/

preferences.name: redIssues
preferences.title: Red Issues Priorities
preferences.description: A comma separated list of Priority names to mark with a red dot (e.g. 'Critical, Urgent, High')

preferences.name: orangeIssues
preferences.title: Orange Issues Priorities
preferences.description: A comma separated list of Priority names to mark with an orange dot (e.g. 'Urgent, High')

preferences.name: blueIssues
preferences.title: Blue Issues Priorities
preferences.description: A comma separated list of Priority names to mark with a blue dot (e.g. 'Low')
